text: Argentine was a great favourite of hers, and it is said she was in a terrible state for sometime after.” A curious look came over Villiers’ face; he seemed undecided whether to speak or not. Austin began again. “I never experienced such a feeling of horror as when I read the account of Argentine’s death. I didn’t understand it at the time, and I don’t now. I knew him well, and it completely passes my understanding for what possible cause he—or any of the others for the matter of that—could have resolved in cold blood to die in such an awful manner.
